plan.details: Auth0 tenants, applications, APIs. JWTs in depth — header, payload, signature, expiry. Flows: Authorization Code + PKCE, Client Credentials, Device. Rules, Actions, M2M. Python SDK integration patterns.

Full spec walkthrough — all grant types, scopes, token introspection, refresh flows. Authentication vs. authorization distinction. Token storage security. Provider comparison: Auth0 vs. Okta vs. Cognito vs. Keycloak.

Transformer architecture simplified. Tokens, context windows, embeddings, temperature, top-p. How models are trained and fine-tuned. Quantization basics. Capabilities and hard limits. Difference between base models, instruction-tuned, and RLHF models.

System prompts and persona design. Few-shot and zero-shot prompting. Chain-of-thought and tree-of-thought. Prompt injection risks and mitigations. Structured output (JSON mode). Evaluating LLM outputs. Prompt versioning and testing strategies.

Anthropic SDK: messages API, streaming, tool use, vision. Model selection and pricing. Caching (prompt caching). Token counting and cost management. Building AI-powered APIs with FastAPI. Error handling and rate limit strategies.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation architecture. Chunking strategies. Embedding models (dense vs. sparse). Vector databases: pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma. Similarity search algorithms (HNSW, IVFFlat). Hybrid search. Evaluating RAG quality.

Agentic patterns: ReAct, plan-and-execute, reflection. Tool/function calling in depth. Multi-agent systems — when they help and when they hurt. Model Context Protocol (MCP): architecture, writing servers, connecting tools. Orchestration: LangChain vs. raw SDK vs. custom.

Org architecture: metadata, objects, fields, relationships. Developer Console vs. VS Code + SFDX. Deployment: change sets vs. packages vs. SFDX. Profiles, permission sets, sharing rules. Governor limits — why they exist and how to work with them. Namespaces and managed packages.

Execution context and governor limit mechanics. Trigger framework patterns — one trigger per object, handler classes. Async Apex: @future, Queueable, Batch, Scheduled. SOQL and SOSL in depth. Bulkification patterns. Exception handling. Unit testing and @isTest. AESF trigger architecture walkthrough.

REST and SOAP API: authentication, limits, error handling. Outbound messages vs. callouts. Platform Events vs. Change Data Capture (CDC) vs. Streaming API. Webhooks: inbound to Salesforce. The Salesforce to middleware to Epic pattern. Canvas and connected apps.

Standard and custom objects, polymorphic lookups, junction objects. SOQL: relationship queries, semi-joins, aggregate functions. SOSL. Query optimization and selective queries. Reporting snapshots. AESF and CanaryAMS object model deep dive.

CPython execution model, bytecode disassembly. The GIL — what it actually blocks. Memory management: reference counting, cyclic GC. Descriptors, __slots__, metaclasses, __init_subclass__. The import system. Profiling with cProfile and py-spy.

asyncio internals: event loop, coroutines, tasks, awaitables. threading vs. multiprocessing vs. asyncio. concurrent.futures. Async context managers. Writing non-blocking FastAPI endpoints. Detecting sync code blocking the async loop.

MVCC and how transactions actually work. VACUUM and autovacuum. WAL (Write-Ahead Logging). Heap and TOAST storage. Connection pooling with PgBouncer. EXPLAIN ANALYZE in depth. pg_stat_* views for diagnostics. Alembic migration best practices.

B-tree, hash, GiST, GIN, BRIN — when to use each. Partial, expression, and covering indexes. Join strategies (hash, nested loop, merge). Query planner statistics and ANALYZE. SQLAlchemy patterns and their SQL output. N+1 detection and fixes.

CAP theorem and PACELC. Consistency models: eventual, strong, causal. Raft consensus simplified. Distributed clocks: Lamport timestamps, vector clocks. Failure modes: split brain, network partitions. How these apply to Postgres replication and Kafka.

Horizontal vs. vertical scaling. Load balancing strategies. Stateless services. Read replicas, write routing. CQRS. Database sharding. Idempotency design. Rate limiting algorithms (token bucket, leaky bucket). Analyzing your own middleware architecture.

REST maturity levels and Richardson model. Versioning strategies. Hypermedia/HATEOAS. gRPC and Protobuf: when it beats REST. GraphQL: schema design, N+1 problem, DataLoader. OpenAPI/Swagger spec design. FastAPI best practices for large APIs.

Event-driven vs. request-driven. Kafka internals: brokers, partitions, consumer groups, offsets. Exactly-once semantics. Event sourcing. CQRS + event sourcing. Dead letter queues. Comparison to your current queue-table-based async pattern.

Container internals: namespaces and cgroups. Multi-stage Dockerfiles. Kubernetes architecture: control plane, kubelet, etcd. Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets. Services, Ingress, NetworkPolicy. HPA. Helm chart authoring. Reading your own deployment-manifests as a case study.

Resource hierarchy: org, folders, projects. VPC, Cloud NAT, firewall rules. IAM and service accounts — least privilege. Cloud Run vs. GKE vs. Compute Engine. Cloud SQL, Memorystore, Pub/Sub. Workload Identity Federation. Secrets Manager vs. Vault.

ETL vs. ELT. Idempotent and restartable pipelines. Incremental vs. full-load. Watermarking and CDC. Schema evolution. Orchestration: Airflow vs. Prefect vs. cron. Error handling and dead letter patterns. Pentaho/PDI architecture in your BDE and BQ ETL pipelines.

BigQuery internals: columnar storage, Dremel execution engine. Partitioning and clustering. Slot-based vs. on-demand billing. Window functions and analytical SQL. Slowly changing dimensions. Star schema vs. OBT. Streaming inserts vs. batch load. Your BQ ETL in depth.

The three pillars. Structured logging best practices. Metrics: counters, gauges, histograms. Prometheus scraping. Distributed tracing: OpenTelemetry, trace context propagation. Datadog APM and log correlation. Alerting design — avoiding alert fatigue.

Latency vs. throughput. Profiling Python: cProfile, line_profiler, py-spy in production. Cache-aside, write-through, write-behind patterns. Redis data structures and use cases. Distributed vs. local cache. Cache stampede. HTTP load testing with locust.

OWASP Top 10 — mechanisms and mitigations. Input validation, parameterized queries. Secrets management. SSRF, XXE, deserialization attacks. Dependency scanning. mTLS between services. Security in CI/CD. Threat modeling your own integration platform.

SLOs, SLIs, SLAs. Error budgets. Chaos engineering basics. Graceful degradation. Incident response runbooks. Post-mortem culture — blameless analysis. CI/CD: blue-green, canary, zero-downtime DB migrations.

Test pyramid. Property-based testing with Hypothesis. Contract testing (Pact) for API integrations. Mutation testing. Testcontainers for real DB tests. Testing async code. Testing Salesforce integrations and ETL pipelines.

Staff engineer archetypes. Writing RFCs and design docs. ADRs — format and lifecycle. C4 architecture diagrams. Making decisions under uncertainty. Driving alignment without authority. Mentoring. Engineering culture. Designing the 2027 plan.
